title: Council proposal
description: Output of a council member at the proposal stage (written without seeing other members) and at each revision round (the member's position after reading the critiques). The facilitator's synthesis builds the brief's options, votes and dissent from these.

priority.description: The priority you argue from, as your seat names it, e.g. simplicity.

position.description: Your answer to the council's question in a few sentences, and why it follows from your priority.

recommendation.description: Name of the option you recommend; one of options.

options.description: Every option you considered, the recommended one included, and at least one real alternative (doing nothing counts when it is one).

summary.description: What the option is, in a few sentences.

cost.description: Effort and running cost compared with the other options.

risk.description: How likely and how bad a failure of this option is.

evidence.description: Every factual claim your position, options and risks rest on, each with its source.

risks.description: What could go wrong with your recommendation.

mitigation.description: How it is prevented, detected or limited.

revision.description: null at the proposal stage. At a revision round: whether your position changed since your last contribution, and why.

changed.description: true when your recommendation or position changed.

reason.description: The argument or evidence that changed your position, or why the critiques did not.

prompted_by.description: Members whose critique changed it, as role@runtime; empty exactly when nothing changed.
